title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana/log-shipping for Private installs
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Private (VPC/on‑prem) installs currently require manual wiring of Prometheus, Grafana dashboards, and log shipping (Vector/Fluent Bit). This results in long setup times for customers and brittle upgrade workflows. This PR adds opinionated automation for the observability stack as part of the private installer: Helm chart improvements, Terraform module for observability resources, pre-bundled Grafana dashboards, PrometheusRule alert templates, and automated log-shipping manifests. The description below is a single continuous string containing scope, implementation, testing, and rollout/rollback instructions. Scope: 1) Add an optional observability module to the private installer that provisions Prometheus (kube-prometheus-stack), Grafana with bundled dashboards, and a choice of Vector or Fluent Bit for log shipping. 2) Add Terraform module wiring to create required IAM roles, network endpoints, and storage classes in supported environments. 3) Provide Helm values, Kustomize overlays, and upgrade hooks to ensure safe rollouts and automated data retention settings. 4) Include PrometheusRule templates and Alertmanager config snippets tuned for Private installs (disk pressure, kvcache evictions, inference-runtime errors, request latency SLOs). 5) Provide automated dashboard provisioning and a migration guide for existing customers. Key implementation details: - Helm: new chart redwood-priv-observability under redwood-private-installer/helm/observability. It contains subcharts: prometheus-operator (kube-prometheus-stack) pinned to curated chart version, grafana with sidecar for provisioning, and vector-fluent for log shipping. Values expose toggles (enablePrometheus, enableGrafana, logAgent=vector|fluentbit), resource profiles (small/medium/large), and retention windows. - Terraform: redwood-private-installer/terraform/modules/observability introduces a module that creates optional cloud-native resources (if cloud provider detected) and outputs kubeconfig and helm release metadata. - Grafana: dashboards in redwood-private-installer/helm/observability/grafana/dashboards curated for private infra metrics (node/gpu utilization, serving runtime latencies, batching effectiveness, KV cache hit/miss, inference error rates). Dashboards are provisioned through Grafana sidecar and can be read from a ConfigMap for air-gapped installs. - Alerts: prometheusRules/prometheus-rules.yaml includes recommended alerts and runbook links. Rules are templated with namespace and label selectors to avoid firing across tenants. - Upgrade/rollback: Helm hooks added to create/backup PVCs for Prometheus data and pre-upgrade checks ensure resource quotas exist. A post-upgrade migration script migrates dashboards and alert rules with idempotent behavior. - CI: unit tests for Terraform plan validations, Helm linting, kustomize overlays and integration tests in perf-canary that deploy a minimal Private stack to a test cluster. Migration & operational guidance: - Default install is opt-in via installer flag --enable-observability; existing installs are unchanged by default. - Migration path documented in redwood-private-installer/docs/observability-migration.md including helm upgrade commands and a dry-run flag. - Rollback plan: helm rollback <release> will revert charts; Prometheus PVC snapshots are taken automatically before upgrade. - Security: Grafana provisioning supports read-only viewer role for SRE and optional LDAP/SAML integration for enterprise customers. Testing and CI: - Ran end-to-end validation in perf-canary against k8s 1.25 and 1.27 clusters and on an air-gapped lab environment. - Terraform module validated with terraform validate/plan; charts pass helm lint and chart-testing pipeline. - Performance smoke tests show no >5% overhead on the runtime in small/medium profiles. Backwards compatibility and limitations: - The module supports cloud and on-prem but requires a storage class for Prometheus PVCs; installer will fail fast with a clear error message if missing. - Alert thresholds are conservative by default and should be tuned per-customer. Rollout plan: Gradual rollout to allowed private installs behind a feature flag for 2 weeks; monitor alert noise and dashboard integrity. Related work: Linear ENG-4123 (observability private installer), ENG-4180 (prometheus operator pin), SRE-210 (alert tuning), PM-98 (observability UX).

review_thread: Ethan Cole: Please ensure the prometheus operator chart version is pinned and documented (commented in values.yaml).
Priya Nair: Addressed: pinned to 45.3.0 and added note in values.yaml. PTAL.
María González: Can we add a toggle to disable persistent storage for test clusters?
Priya Nair: Added 'usePersistentStorage' flag with sane defaults; installer will set false for perf-canary deployments.
Sven Huber: Alert rule for 'inference_runtime_error_rate' looks aggressive for small clusters — recommend higher threshold and a longer for: duration.
Priya Nair: Tuned threshold to 1.5% and for: 5m per SRE suggestion.
release_notes:
- Added optional observability module for Private installs: Prometheus, Grafana, and log shipping (Vector/Fluent Bit).
- Terraform module to provision observability-related infra for private installs.
- Pre-bundled Grafana dashboards for serving runtime and node GPU metrics.
- PrometheusRule templates and Alertmanager snippets tuned for private deployments.
- Installer flags and migration guide for safe upgrade/rollback.
